messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Get emergency medical help if you have signs of an allergic reaction to potassium chloride: hives; difficult breathing; swelling of your face, lips, tongue, or throat.
Stop using this medicine and call your doctor at once if you have:
- severe throat irritation;
- stomach bloating, severe vomiting, severe stomach pain;
- high potassium level - nausea, weakness, tingly feeling, chest pain, irregular heartbeats, loss of movement; or
- signs of stomach bleeding - bloody or tarry stools, coughing up blood or vomit that looks like coffee grounds.
Common potassium chloride side effects may include:
- nausea, vomiting, diarrhea;
- gas, stomach pain; or
- the appearance of a potassium chloride tablet in your stool.
This is not a complete list of side effects and others may occur. Call your doctor for medical advice about side effects. You may report side effects to FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088.
Triplet: ["Potassium Chloride", "has serious side effect symptom", "hives"]

The relation 'has serious side effect symptom' in the triplet is defined as 'An occurrence of the serious side effect associated with the subject drug may include the symptom specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
C. 'has overdose symptom': An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
D. 'has side effect frequency': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect specified by the object entity with the frequency indicated.
E. 'has overdose risk': An overdose of the subject drug may result in the serious or life-threatening consequence specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
